mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_product (interest_type_id, repayment_method_id, name, additional_rate) VALUES (#{interestType.interestTypeId}, #{repaymentMethod.repaymentMethodId}, #{name}, #{additionalRate})
mapper.select: SELECT lp.loan_product_id, lp.name, lp.additional_rate, lp.created_at, lp.updated_at, it.interest_type_id, it.name AS interest_type_name, rm.repayment_method_id, rm.name AS repayment_method_name FROM loan_product lp JOIN interest_type it ON lp.interest_type_id = it.interest_type_id JOIN repayment_method rm ON lp.repayment_method_id = rm.repayment_method_id WHERE lp.loan_product_id = #{loanProductId}
